headline: EPS rises from last quarter but trails last year
summary_short: Quarterly EPS was ¥50.96 versus ¥61.62 a year ago, down 17.3%, and up 20.6% from ¥42.24 in the prior quarter.
summary_long: Earnings per share of ¥50.96 compares with ¥61.62 in the same quarter a year earlier and ¥42.24 last quarter. These are the only verified figures on file; a web search found only first-quarter results of the fiscal year, so revenue, adjusted EBITA, drivers and guidance for this period are not reported.
